content:
Long before horror films brought demonic possession to the screen, accounts of devils and exorcisms were already frightening communities. What lies behind those disturbing stories?

LISTEN TO THE FULL INTERVIEW HERE > https://open.spotify.com/episode/3fbjTnMOV3EBbHoHUxvkGW

Bestselling paranormal author G. L. Davies welcomes returning guest, researcher and author Paul Weatherhead to The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast for “Demons, Exorcism & Historical Strange Tales!” The 55-minute episode explores the peculiar history of demons and exorcism, along with mysteries such as the Lancashire Seven and the Halifax Slasher.

For listeners fascinated by paranormal history, these names offer a compelling starting point. How should we approach accounts of possession from centuries ago? What did people believe they were witnessing? And why do certain frightening stories continue to capture our imagination long after the original events?

Weatherhead, author of Demonic Lancashire and Phantoms of Christmas Past, brings a longstanding interest in unusual history to the conversation. His writing has appeared in Psychology Today, The Skeptic and Northern Life, reflecting research interests that span folklore, strange experiences and the ways people interpret them.

Hosted by Davies, author of Haunted: Horror of Haverfordwest, the episode invites curious newcomers and committed paranormal enthusiasts alike to explore a past filled with unsettling claims and unanswered questions. It’s an intriguing listen for anyone drawn to historical mysteries, demonic possession, exorcism stories, and the darker corners of British folklore.
